svg.data-what: an islet of Langerhans among the enzyme-making acini of the pancreas

g.data-what: acini of the exocrine pancreas, around the islet: cells packed with granules of digestive enzymes, released into the ducts

path.data-what: a small duct carrying the enzymes toward the gut
an islet of Langerhans: about a thousand cells making hormones straight into the blood; a pancreas holds about a million of them

g.data-what: a dense net of capillaries, so the hormones reach the blood at once
beta cells, most of the islet: they release insulin when blood sugar rises
alpha cells, toward the rim: they release glucagon when blood sugar falls
delta cells, a few: they release somatostatin, which damps the other two
